options.name: categories
options.description: Array of information types that should be written to the database.

options.name: cleanup
options.description: Dictionary with items for historical table cleanup.

options.name: database
options.description: MySQL database name.

options.name: enable_ha
options.description: Enable the high availability functionality. Only valid in a cluster setup.

options.name: extra_options
options.description: Extra options to be passed to the mysql command when applying the database schema.

options.name: failover_timeout
options.description: Set the failover timeout in a HA cluster. Must not be lower than 30s.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: host
options.description: MySQL database host address.

options.name: import_schema
options.description: Whether to apply the database schema.

options.name: instance_description
options.description: Description for the Icinga 2 instance.

options.name: instance_name
options.description: Unique identifier for the local Icinga 2 instance, used for multiple Icinga 2 clusters writing to the same database.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the IdoMySqlConnection object.

options.name: order
options.description: Value to determine internal precedence.

options.name: password
options.description: MySQL database user’s password.

options.name: port
options.description: MySQL database port.

options.name: socket_path
options.description: MySQL socket path.

options.name: ssl_ca
options.description: MySQL SSL certificate authority certificate file path.

options.name: ssl_capath
options.description: MySQL SSL trusted SSL CA certificates in PEM format directory path.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: MySQL SSL certificate file path.

options.name: ssl_cipher
options.description: MySQL SSL list of allowed ciphers.

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: MySQL SSL client key file path.

options.name: ssl_mode
options.description: The SSL mode to be used with the mysql command when applying the database schema.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the IdoMySqlConnection object.

options.name: table_prefix
options.description: MySQL database table prefix.

options.name: user
options.description: MySQL database user with read/write permission to the icinga database.
